name: Gilman Peterson, DMD, MD
headline: Tooth extractions and wisdom teeth removal on Perimeter Drive in Lexington.
intro: We remove wisdom teeth and other teeth that need to come out, one at a time or several in one visit. Appointments are recommended, so call ahead to get on the schedule.

services.name: Wisdom teeth removal
services.detail: Extraction of wisdom teeth, with a follow-up visit afterward.

services.name: Tooth extractions
services.detail: A single tooth or several in one appointment.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.detail: Ask the office about cosmetic options when you call.

services.name: Payment options
services.detail: Credit, debit, tap-to-pay and payment plans.

reviews.author: Bobby Corwin
reviews.text: Amazing, friendly,  very professional, and understanding staff. It feels like they really care about you. Had wisdom teeth pulled the other week and Dr. Peterson did it without any sedation, and I did not feel a thing, and I had little to no swelling and bleeding, which is the mark of a good Maxillofacial Surgeon.

reviews.author: Crystal Quick-Justice
reviews.text: I had to have 3 teeth extracted and cut out. I had a little pain the first day, but zero pain the next morning. The staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: Cathy Adams
reviews.text: My grandaughter had a tooth pulled and never felt a thing. Great experience all the way around.
